disclaimer: Simplified estimate under IRP (Impuesto a la Renta Personal), Law No. 6380/2019. Paraguay uses a TERRITORIAL tax system: only Paraguay-sourced income is taxed, for residents and non-residents alike; foreign-sourced income is fully exempt regardless of residency, which this calculator does not model. The personal allowance (approx. 50 minimum wages/year) and social security (IPS) contributions are not included as a separate deduction beyond the exemption threshold already built into the slabs below.

regimes.label: Resident (IRP)
regimes.notes: SIMPLIFIED: IRP does not apply at all below roughly PYG 80,000,000/year gross (modeled here as a combined 0% band approximating both the gross-income liability threshold and the separate ~PYG 65M personal allowance netted against income). Above that, the real law applies progressive rates of 8%/9%/10% to net taxable income in PYG 50M-wide bands (Article 69, Law 6380/2019) — approximated below as bands starting from the PYG 80M exemption point rather than from PYG 0, since this engine cannot separate a liability threshold from a personal allowance.

regimes.label: Non-Resident
regimes.notes: Non-residents (INR) are taxed at a flat 15%, though some service categories use a deemed tax base of around 30% of gross income (effectively 4.5% of gross) depending on the type of service — this calculator applies the simpler flat 15% on gross.

residency_threshold_note: ADVISORY ONLY, not a legal determination: 183+ days physically present in a tax year is commonly used as a resident-status guideline. Actual rules vary by country (tie-breaker tests, visa type, permanent home, center of vital interests, etc.) and this figure does not override your own judgment or professional advice.
